# Dying light 2 configuration
RESET_MAPPINGS

REAL_WORLD_CALIBRATION = 400		# Change if making a full circle with right stick doesn't move character camera in the same way.
IN_GAME_SENS = 50					# Should be same as in game

##### LEFT ANALOG STICK
LLEFT = Q							# Menu tabs and ammo swap
LRIGHT = E							# Menu tabs and ammo swap
LUP = V								# car camera
#LDOWN = Z+X							

##### STICK CLICK
L3 = ENTER        					# Enter
R3 = Q             					# Survivor Sense   

L3+R3 = Z+X							# BEAST MODE   

##### D-PAD (movement)
LEFT = A           	 				# Movement
RIGHT = D           
UP = W             			
DOWN = S     						# Movement end

##### TRIGGERS AND BUMPERS
ZR = LSHIFT							# chroding
ZL = RMOUSE							# Block/aim
R = LMOUSE             				# Shoot/attack
L =  SPACE       					# Jump

##### FACE BUTTONS (YBAX)
N = MMOUSE								# Use Consumable
E = C       						# Crouch
S = E 								# Kick
W = F 								# Use
W,W = Z 							# Glider(?)

##### CHORDED PRESSES WITH RIGHT TRIGGER
ZR,N = 2							# Cycle Consumables
ZR,E = 3							# Cycle Weapons
ZR,S = T 							# Flashlight        
ZR,W = 1							# Cycle Equipment

##### CHORDED PRESSES WITH SELECT BUTTON
#-,N = 2							# Cycle Consumables
#-,E = 3							# Cycle Equipment
#-,S = 4 							# Flashlight        
#-,W = 1							# Cycle Weapons



##### START AND SELECT
+ = I ESC 							# invenory       
- = N M								# clock, map
#- = ESC          					# menu

#############
TOUCHPAD_MODE = GRID_AND_STICK
GRID_SIZE = 2 1   					# split the pad in two buttons, left and right
GYRO_OFF = TOUCH    				# disable the gyro when I touch

# Bind on clicks

CAPTURE = NONE   					# Chorded with touch buttons
T1,CAPTURE = R  					# reload? repair equipment
T2,CAPTURE = H 				# Use equipment	
#############

#TUTORIAL
#PS = 								# --- 						(Ps button)
#CAPTURE =          				# ---						(Touchpad click)
#TOUCH = 							# --- 						(Touchpad touch)
#Use W = R E    		    		# if you want E on hold button

#https://github.com/Electronicks/JoyShockMapper#commands - good list of commands and inputs

# Include mouse settings
# If you are not happy with sensitivity change it in that file.
GyroConfigs/_3Dmouse.txt
